69407.subject: Physics
69407.text: In n-type semiconductor A) pentavalent impurity are dopants and holes are majority carriers. B) trivalent impurity are dopants and electrons are minority carriers. C) pentavalent impurity are dopants and electrons are majority carriers. D) trivalent impurity are dopants and holes are majority carriers.
69407.sol: An n-type semiconductor is obtained by doping an intrinsic semiconductor with pentavalent impurity atoms such as Phosphorus, Arsenic, or Antimony. Each pentavalent atom donates one extra electron to the crystal lattice, making electrons the majority charge carriers. Holes are generated only by thermal excitation and act as the minority charge carriers. Therefore, in an n-type semiconductor, pentavalent impurities are the dopants and electrons are the majority carriers. Answer: C

70993.subject: Biology
70993.text: Which special feature among the following is seen in frogs for gaseous exchange through the skin?
options: Exoskeleton in the form of scales.
70993.sol: Frogs exhibit cutaneous respiration, which is the exchange of gases across the skin. For efficient diffusion of gases, the skin must be thin, highly vascularized, and kept moist by mucus glands. A thick, dry, or non-vascular skin would prevent gaseous exchange. Frogs also lack an exoskeleton in the form of scales. Answer: Skin is thin and moist.

The offspring produced from this cross will have the following genotypes and phenotypes: RrYy : Round Yellow Rryy : Round Green rrYy : Wrinkled Yellow rryy : Wrinkled Green Thus, four different phenotypes are obtained in a ratio of 1:1:1:1 . 71509.sol: In non-recurrent apomixis, the megaspore mother cell undergoes normal meiotic division to form a haploid embryo sac. 132850.sol: Charles Darwin is credited with the theory of natural selection. Water with dissolved inorganic and organic substances and also the soil at the bottom

The global gross national product is nearly half of the price tag given to ecosystem services.
Of the total of various ecosystem services, the soil formation accounts for about 50 per cent.
The cost of climate regulation and habitat for wildlife are about 6 percent together.
96615.sol: An American ecological economist, Robert Constanza with his team worked out the monetary value on natural ecosystem services. His work research estimated that ecosystem services cost approx. US 33 trillion per year. These services are largely considered free. Of the total cost for the services, nearly 6% each for climate regulation and habitat for wildlife. Together is 12%. Soil formation accounts for 50%.

Kingdom Protista includes organisms with well-defined nucleus (eukaryotes) which have a single cell. Kingdom Plantae includes multicellular eukaryotes that are autotrophic. Kingdom Fungi includes multicellular eukaryotes that are saprophytic. Kingdom Animalia includes multicellular eukaryotes that are holozoic.

6a7a1ff877549dd17f1925f2.sol: The height of capillary rise or fall is given by h = 2S g r . For liquid X , the height is positive (capillary rise), which implies _X > 0 .
